design_rule: Each cue is a causal visual sentence. No unlisted asset, generic finance wallpaper, chart, statistic, page, or overlay may appear in this wave.

cues.purpose: Open on the reversal before naming either side.
must_show: one red bubble tag above the wrong shaft
must_not_imply: a price chart is evidence by itself
cues.entry_action: the bubble tag slides to the wrong elevator
cues.exit_action: cut into the memory-side price reaction

cues.purpose: Make the viewer feel why a rapid AI-memory move invites a bubble diagnosis, then immediately ground that reaction in the retained one-year comparison.
must_show: three local return strips for MU, KOSPI, and S&P 500
one shared local qualifier: 1Y through Aug. 7, adjusted close
must_not_imply: that the three assets are interchangeable
cues.micro_event: the three evidence strips lock to the corresponding chip, Korea, and broad-index symbols
cues.exit_action: warning stamp hard-cuts to the spoken word bubble

cues.purpose: Stage the ordinary, reasonable reflex before the mechanism turns.
must_not_imply: the analyst is wrong for being cautious
cues.micro_event: placard folds into a question mark

cues.purpose: Replace the surface chart with the three physical/economic supports named in the narration.
must_show: memory module leaving a constrained fab
factory line with visible capacity bottleneck
buyer contract page with generic unsigned terms
cues.entry_action: factory gate opens as product exits
cues.micro_event: three supports assemble into one cable
cues.exit_action: cable matches into index-fund inflow arrows

cues.purpose: Make the contrast legible: automatic contributions enter a recognizable market-cap-weighted fund where a top tier is visually dominant.
must_show: fund container or ledger clearly recognizable as an index fund
cues.entry_action: cash tokens enter the fund container
cues.micro_event: top tier expands while a local 40-percent surface locks
cues.exit_action: fund splits into concentration and dilution paths

cues.purpose: Preserve the script's three qualifications before the thesis lands.
must_show: three removable risk cards: correction, overpriced, cyclical
same memory cable from prior cue
cues.entry_action: three cards cut into frame one at a time
cues.micro_event: each card stays visible rather than being crossed out

cues.purpose: Land the early answer as a constrained physical process, not a valuation claim.
must_show: memory modules queued at a narrow factory gate
must_not_imply: every memory stock is fairly valued
cues.micro_event: cable carries a module across the frame
cues.exit_action: the cable turns into an index-fund belt

cues.purpose: Turn attention from the dramatic trade to the unexamined default product.
must_show: quiet index-fund box on a household shelf
cues.entry_action: inspection lamp leaves the memory cable

cues.purpose: Correct the price-up shortcut with a diagnostic distinction.
cues.entry_action: price-up icon stamps then slides aside

cues.purpose: Show the difference between next-buyer belief and a productive/scarcity/cash-flow support stack.
must_show: upward elevator supported by crowds jumping
separate support stack labeled locally only when composited
must_not_imply: cash flow or scarcity guarantees a return
cues.micro_event: second elevator reveals physical support layers
cues.exit_action: both elevators align side by side

cues.purpose: Deliver the recurring elevator metaphor: same visible ascent, different causal system.
must_not_imply: the elevator analogy measures price performance
cues.micro_event: floor opens under each to expose its mechanism
cues.exit_action: cut below the floors for the next chapter's cable inventory

gate_a_request: Approve the causal visual language, the first-wave asset-demand kinds, and the single claim-bound top-ten-weight statistic before source retrieval or image generation.
